Within this exact pinned manager.py surface there is no generation or explicit propagation of a root_task_id into manager_bounded_handoff.

Because the selected route surface delegates through manager_message, this file alone does not establish or disprove whether manager_bridge later invokes manager_bounded_handoff with name_session=true and a generated non-null root_task_id. Inspecting manager_bridge would be a second production surface and is intentionally deferred.
